blocks.text: Artist, actor, and performer SVRN unveils “ONE THING I CAN’T LIVE WITHOUT”, a vibrant, feel-good track that blends contemporary pop with the groove of disco R&B to create an upbeat, dance-driven sound that invites listeners to move along. Fans can listen to the song here and watch the music video here. If you were asked to name one thing you couldn’t live without, what would you say? For many, “money” might be one of the first answers that comes to mind.
